title: Controlled harmonic map heat flow and blow-up from the disk to the sphere
summary: We study the one-corotational harmonic map heat flow from the disk to the sphere with a Dirichlet boundary control. We introduce a control-adapted gluing strategy to prevent blow-up. More precisely, we construct explicit upper profiles and well-prepared boundary traces such that every nonnegative datum below one of these profiles and having boundary value above $π$ blows up under the corresponding constant trace, whereas the corresponding solution is global under every control below the associated well-prepared boundary trace.
